$comment: D7 full participant snapshot: audience 'participants', ≤32KiB, ≤20Hz, addressed only to accepted players and subscribed watchers (never room-wide broadcast_frame). serverTick/snapshotSeq order motion independently of lifecycle revision. Private reconciliation (self) is a separate attachment only for the recipient.
name: snapshot-full

privateAttachment.$comment: Delivered only to user-1111's connection alongside/below the snapshot; never broadcast.

invariants: appliedSeq/heldControls/self appear only in the private attachment, never in the shared payload or summary
lastAcceptedSeqs is diagnostic and must not acknowledge prediction replay
no raw input history, leases, tokens or requestId of others ever travels in this message
max 8 riders, 8 splits each, bounded names; whole payload must re-encode under 32KiB
equal revision with higher snapshotSeq is ACCEPTED motion (revision equality is not stale)
lower snapshotSeq or wrong epoch/session/match is dropped by clients
resetSeq increments on crash recovery teleport so clients clear interpolation buffers
